page_title: FUL 3-1 SHU | Fulham v Sheffield Utd 07/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' That's it for today, Samuel Barrott has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+9' Rodrigo Muniz receives a sweet cross inside the box from Timothy Castagne (Fulham), but one of the defenders rushes in bravely to intercept the ball.
90+7' Tom Cairney (Fulham) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
90+2' 3 - 1 Goal! Willian (Fulham) gathered the ball off a rebound inside the box and fired home into the bottom right corner.
90+1' Oliver Norwood (Sheffield Utd) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Samuel Barrott had an easy-decision to make.
90' We will have 8 min. of added time.
89' Willian (Fulham) picks up a pass and hits the ball towards goal, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Wesley Foderingham.
88' Oliver McBurnie (Sheffield Utd) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the resulting corner, but he sends his header straight at the goalkeeper.
88' Oliver Norwood (Sheffield Utd) will take the corner.
88' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Oliver Norwood (Sheffield Utd), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders. Sheffield Utd earn a corner.
87' Fulham concede a free kick following a bad challenge. Sheffield Utd have been awarded a free kick.
86' A cross from Timothy Castagne (Fulham) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
84' Harry Wilson (Fulham) decided to surprise the goalkeeper with a quick shot from the edge of the box, but his effort came back off the left post!
79' The manager makes a subsitution with Rhian Brewster (Sheffield Utd) coming on for Cameron Archer.
79' Harrison Reed (Fulham) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Alex Iwobi.
78' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Carlos Vinicius leaves the pitch and Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham) comes on.
78' Marco Silva prepares a substitution. Bobby De Cordova-Reid is replaced by Harry Wilson (Fulham).
76' 2 - 1 OWN GOAL! Wesley Foderingham (Sheffield Utd) scores an unlucky own goal after he deflected a shot which went into his own net! 2:1.
76' Tom Cairney (Fulham) unleashes a tremendous shot from distance, but it crashes against the crossbar! If it had flown a little bit lower it would have been a cracker!
73' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Oliver McBurnie (Sheffield Utd) was quite harsh and Samuel Barrott didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
71' Here is a change. Andreas Pereira is going off and Marco Silva gives the last tactical orders to Tom Cairney (Fulham).
71' That will be all from Issa Diop who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Calvin Bassey (Fulham).
71' Samuel Barrott sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
70' Wait! Referee Samuel Barrott has indicated he is going to review the Sheffield Utd goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
68' 1 - 1 Own goal! Antonee Robinson (Fulham) suffers a good deal of misfortune as he accidentally puts a pass from one of the attacking players into his own net. The score is 1:1.
68' Fulham force their opponents to concede a corner.
68' Willian (Fulham) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger. The referee blows his whistle, Fulham are awarded a corner kick.
66' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Yasser Larouci (Sheffield Utd) replaces Luke Thomas.
66' Oliver Norwood (Sheffield Utd) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
66' Substitution. Gustavo Hamer walks off the pitch and James McAtee (Sheffield Utd) comes on as a substitute.
66' Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) pounced on a rebound on the edge of the box and his shot goes a whisker over the crossbar.
66' Jayden Bogle (Sheffield Utd) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The referee points to the corner flag and Sheffield Utd will take a corner.
64' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) trips an opposition player and Samuel Barrott signals a foul. There is a free kick near the sideline to Sheffield Utd.
62' Willian (Fulham) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Wesley Foderingham intercepts the ball.
62' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.

61' Bobby De Cordova-Reid (Fulham) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a clever chip pass, but one of the defending players comes up with a timely interception. The ball goes out for a corner. Fulham can continue in their attacking effort.
60' Vini Souza (Sheffield Utd) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
59' Vini Souza (Sheffield Utd) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
58' Oliver McBurnie (Sheffield Utd) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area.
56' 3:1 – this is the current number of shots on target.

53' 1 - 0 Goal! Andreas Pereira plays a long ball to Bobby De Cordova-Reid (Fulham), who cuts inside and unleashes a screamer into the bottom left corner. The keeper had no chance. Superb strike! 1:0.
52' Fulham can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

52' That's unlucky! Bobby De Cordova-Reid (Fulham) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared. The linesman makes the right call and Fulham will have a corner.
50' Joao Palhinha (Fulham) has tested the patience of referee Samuel Barrott and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
49' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Sheffield Utd.

48' Oliver Norwood (Sheffield Utd) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender. Sheffield Utd force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
46' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) unleashes a cannonball of a shot from the edge of the area, but it zips narrowly wide of the left post.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+16' Samuel Barrott has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+15' Willian (Fulham) sprays a pass out to Carlos Vinicius, but he can't beat his man inside the box.
45+14' Cameron Archer (Sheffield Utd) fouls an opponent during an attacking move. Fulham have a free kick.
45+14' Joao Palhinha (Fulham) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Samuel Barrott saw the whole situation. Sheffield Utd have a free kick.
45+13' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) does well to meet a cross from Willian, but he directs his shot just over the crossbar.
45+12' Samuel Barrott interrupts the game. One of the players from Fulham won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. A free kick has been awarded to Sheffield Utd.
45+11' The corner from Andreas Pereira (Fulham) is hurriedly cleared.
45+10' The ball is cleared after Bobby De Cordova-Reid (Fulham) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Fulham.
45+9' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) tricks his way to the edge of the box where he shoots at goal. The keeper scrambles to cover the effort, but it goes just wide of the left post.
45+7' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
45+5' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) works the corner short.
45+4' Vini Souza (Sheffield Utd) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
45+4' Vini Souza (Sheffield Utd) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.

45+3' Timothy Castagne (Fulham) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Fulham will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
45+2' Carlos Vinicius (Fulham) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sheffield Utd.
45' There will be a minimum of 14 min. of added time.
44' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
43' Bobby De Cordova-Reid (Fulham) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked.
42' Carlos Vinicius (Fulham) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
39' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
38' Joao Palhinha (Fulham) collects a sweet pass on the edge of the box and in one movement smashes a shot in on goal, but it balloons high over the bar.
35' Chris Basham (Sheffield Utd) is being substituted because of an injury. Paul Heckingbottom sends Jack Robinson on the pitch.
23' The game is stopped. Chris Basham (Sheffield Utd) suffers a horrific leg break!
21' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) takes the corner with a short pass.
20' Willian (Fulham) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The ball goes out of play and Fulham have been awarded a corner kick.
19' Willian (Fulham) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a shot towards the middle of the net, but Wesley Foderingham is alert and denies him.
17' Samuel Barrott blows his whistle and it's Issa Diop (Fulham) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee. A free kick to Sheffield Utd.
16' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) takes the corner.
16' Willian (Fulham) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Fulham.
15' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Antonee Robinson (Fulham).
13' Cameron Archer (Sheffield Utd) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fulham.
12' A player from Sheffield Utd commits a rough challenge. Samuel Barrott blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. That's a free kick to Fulham.
10' Luke Thomas (Sheffield Utd) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery. The ball goes out of play and Fulham will have a goal kick.
7' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.

6' What a goal-scoring opportunity! Bobby De Cordova-Reid (Fulham) makes a good run into the box to meet a cross and fires the ball in on goal, but the shot is amazingly blocked by a defender. Fulham have been awarded a corner kick.
5' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
4' Willian (Fulham) bursts past a couple of players and shoots from the edge of the box, but his shot is blocked.
3' Willian (Fulham) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
2' The corner kick from Andreas Pereira (Fulham) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
1' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Timothy Castagne (Fulham). Fulham will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out at last! Fulham will take the kick-off.
Samuel Barrott will referee today's match.
